findings.summary: Web-search boundary observation bound payloadDigest to the raw query hash instead of the canonical arguments fingerprint; the execution gate rejected every hop (observed operation widened), which was the root cause of on-device web search failing while legacy curl worked.
findings.remediation: Bind payloadDigest and requestBytes to sanitizedArguments; web adapter now rethrows AgentContractError instead of swallowing it into 'no results'.

findings.summary: A run whose tools failed or were uncertain still terminated as a clean .completed; the UI then showed a green Completed next to failed tool rows.
findings.remediation: Added AgentTerminalReason.completedWithFailures, updated AgentRunStatus/AgentResult invariants, runtime counts failed/uncertain outcomes at finalize, UI renders 'Completed with issues' (amber) and a failed finalization step. Unit tests cover tool-failure-then-answer.

findings.summary: Repeating an already-executed tool call failed the whole run; small local models do this routinely after a successful tool call.
findings.remediation: One bounded duplicate-repair with an explicit 'do not call any tool again' instruction; a second repetition fails with noProgress. Duplicate-repair and malformed-action repair budgets are independent counters.

findings.summary: remember/recall (and later calendar/reminders/location) are opt-in seams absent from ToolRegistry.standard, so the frozen catalog advertised 'descriptorMissing' and every valid model call was rejected.
findings.remediation: Static schemas for all seam tools; frozen catalog now explicitly advertises them when enabled and their seam is available; schema-parity guard test added.

findings.summary: Per-attempt active-time reservation (60s) equaled the request timeout; a 565ms decode overrun on a warm device failed budget settlement and killed a healthy run.
findings.remediation: Reserve 2x the request timeout per attempt, still bounded by the run ceiling.

findings.summary: Chat options toggles mutated global settings but never updated an already-materialized conversation policy, so the promised 'applies to the next send' did not hold for existing threads.
findings.remediation: Chat options now explicitly re-materializes the active conversation policy (marked as an explicit per-conversation edit). Unit test added.

findings.summary: Web search had no working engine on iOS (DuckDuckGo/Bing anti-bot, Brave empty-200 to gzip), and the adapter plan could name fallback engines the run ceiling had not granted.
findings.remediation: Brave fallback + settings migration; plans are intersected with the ceiling; Bing switched to its RSS output that works under URLSession gzip.

findings.summary: Calendar/reminder adapters defaulted to a 15s timeout while the static catalog declared 5s; every plan would have failed preparedPlanMismatch.
findings.remediation: Registrations now pass explicit per-tool timeouts matching the catalog.

findings.summary: Run panel rendered internal durable markers (execution.tool-attempt-started) as failed steps next to a Completed run.
findings.remediation: Only genuinely uncertain diagnostics surface as steps; internal markers are dropped.

findings.summary: Production Memory snapshot composition now applies the Memory switch, shared relevance ranking, and committed-store freshness. Production assembly regressions cover exclusion, relevance, and next-send saves. On 2026-10-22 the real online simulator case saved a Chinese fact and recalled it in a new conversation without a Memory-settings refresh or recall tool. This closes the issue previously recorded as OPEN-007.
